title: page-pair-diff testbed expected-issues (intent tier)
description: Hand-authored intent for one variant: which issues the tool MUST emit (required), which it MUST NOT emit (forbidden), and the acceptable DiffResult.status. Matchers are deliberately minimal — pin the intent, never over-specify scores or pixel counts.

status.description: Acceptable DiffResult.status value(s). String for exact, array when more than one is acceptable.

required.description: Each entry must be satisfied by at least one distinct emitted issue.

forbidden.description: No emitted issue may satisfy any of these matchers.

maxIssues.description: Optional hard cap on total emitted issues (after baseline suppression). Use 0 for the identical control.

notes.description: Intent statement plus any accepted knock-on issues declared in the variant manifest.

type.description: Taxonomy string (spec §7.3). A trailing '*' is a prefix wildcard, e.g. 'missing_*'.

anyOfTypes.description: Alternative to 'type': matcher satisfied by any one of these taxonomy strings.

anchors.description: Substring matchers against the issue's locator.anchors fields.

evidence.description: Matchers against the issue's evidence block (style-category issues mostly).
